audit_scope: Fresh forensic read-only audit of broad public source/collector/repository/exporter, existing scale review, and all application consumers of PublicObservationIndexV2 and PublicStreamFrameIndexV1. No production edits, tests, or commits by this audit.

classification.basis: There is an ordinary, actionable implementation gap in high-frequency metadata and JSON index amplification plus missing representative sustained capacity qualification. Existing review explicitly says lossless storage is design-only, maximum-breadth two-cycle measurement did not complete, continuous capacity is open, and a finite budget stop alone is not engineering closure. No frozen capital/authority requirement is modified by this classification.

per_due_cycle_at_max_population.basis: Each Bybit product contributes one ticker observation; each Binance product contributes bookTicker, premiumIndex and 24hr. Every accepted receipt gets its own immutable PublicObservationIndexV2 identity. Each current product gets a derived UniverseObservationV2 per publication.

reported_48_hour_linear_growth_projectio.qualification: Conditional multiplication of measured second-cycle growth only; not a benchmark or storage/capacity proof.

evidence_basis.dirty_checkout_note: The worktree contains other Session 41 modifications/untracked artifacts; this audit does not attribute them to the scale review or change them. The reviewed scale-critical source files match the review's recorded digests.
evidence_basis.hash_note: All eight saved source_proof_sha256 values (repository, compact public index, collector, history, production, broad universe, tuning exporter, scale test) match the current files in the target checkout.

Registers immutable rows; generic get/batch metadata/type/page/latest APIs; cutoff-visible public archive history; actual/replay queries; origin accounting pages; exact metadata identity lookup. Owns JSON-expression index definitions and invalid-row/overflow accounting.

Validates broad snapshot refs and chronology, persists exact acquisition receipt/rejections, adopts observations, and binds decision/source lineage; also verifies public observation references during production recovery/adoption.
Loads and validates exact indexed source evidence for shadow model inputs.
Validates public source records used to settle prediction outcomes.
Validates source evidence and complete broad receipt/source-reference membership for strategy-surface decisions.
Checks public source rows used in cross-sectional observations.
Resolves/validates public observation references for event evidence.
Projects public evidence and resolves candidate/source references into desktop read models.
Binds native M15 bars to exact original observation refs for origin accounting.
Counts, validates, and audits indexed public observations during preflight and source readiness checks.
Validates exact source refs and exports public evidence using repository and direct SQLite readers.

PublicStreamFrameIndexV1.role: Persists frame indexes after archive extents and validates existing frame identity while adopting batches.

Routes frame and stream-trade rows through compact public archive locator storage and hydrates exact domain metadata for getters/pages/restart; keeps archive locator queries and fail-closed missing/corrupt extent checks.
Maps exact frame refs to archived row/chunk locators, reconstructs full metadata, validates content/raw hashes and chronology, and maintains a bounded decoded extent cache.
Provides durable public archive extents used by compact frame indexes and restart reconstruction.

index_consumers.important_adjacent_type: PublicStreamTradeObservationIndexV1 shares compact locator behavior with frames; its exact feed identity, actual/replay chronology, event windows, raw bytes, and source distinctions must be preserved in any repository adapter work.

query_and_compatibility_constraints: Preserve the original artifact_ref/content_hash and complete canonical metadata for every row; distinct receipt times and record ids must remain distinct even for equal values.
Preserve created_at_ns versus available_at_ns and raw/index publication chronology, including cutoff visibility, restart reconstruction and tie ordering.

Preserve every indexed SQL predicate and ordering key: exact canonical instrument key versus revision-only lanes, event_type, availability_class, actual versus replay, event time, record id, source id, archive bounds and publication cutoff.

Preserve generic artifact getters, batch ref lookups, type inventory, latest and paged queries, metadata identity pages, public_archive_history_entries, origin accounting pages, and overflow/invalid-row behavior with identical ordering and domain entries.

Preserve exact acquisition receipts, all per-record source refs, rejection identity/reasons/positions, source health, full universe/workset membership, candidate/calendar denominators and immutable hashes.

Preserve export rowid cursors, source_rowid, restart continuation, raw SQL reader bounds, exact metadata limits, invalid-row accounting and full exporter hydration. A compressed design cannot silently omit rows or fall back to older evidence on corrupt/missing storage.
Preserve raw Parquet observation_json and raw_payload_bytes as authoritative exact evidence; compressed metadata must not merge receipts or mutate archive payloads.
Legacy rows and mixed legacy/new rows must remain readable; locator/block write and artifact publication must be atomic and restart-safe under FULL synchronous SQLite/WAL behavior.

root_cause.derived_state_growth: Broad-universe publication also appends per-product UniverseObservationV2 entries plus full UniverseContractV2 and BroadUniverseWorksetV2 snapshots each cycle. Snapshot metadata itself grows with complete universe membership and coverage state.
root_cause.primary: Fresh public market receipts are immutable evidence, so each due poll appends observations and index rows even when values are unchanged. The source identities include new receipt chronology; deduplicating equal payload values would erase distinct acquisitions.
root_cause.storage_amplification: Each PublicObservationIndexV2 row stores full JSON domain metadata, including repeated canonical instrument_key_json and archive/source identity fields. SQLite artifact_index has multiple partial JSON-expression indexes over those rows, and each index repeats some long instrument identity strings. The scale report measures the artifact_index table at 3,911,680 bytes within a 9,781,248-byte logical DB; metadata zlib figures are an opportunity estimate and do not account for indexes, WAL, locators, or decode cost.
root_cause.why_bounded_work_does_not_close_it: The 24-key active history workset bounds expensive recursive history/features, not complete immutable public evidence or the full 4096-product universe. Existing S40 reserve is a floor inherited from the two-symbol stream estimate, not a measured maximum-breadth budget.

smallest_safe_implementation_plan.action: Adopt and freeze the lossless storage contract already documented in SESSION041_SCALE_REVIEW: retain one artifact_index inventory and add bounded compressed canonical-metadata chunks plus exact per-ref locators for PublicObservationIndexV2, UniverseObservationV2, UniverseContractV2, BroadUniverseWorksetV2 and BroadPublicAcquisitionReceiptV2. Keep original refs, hashes, rowids and timestamps. Make repository-owned decode/hydration central and retain legacy-row compatibility.

Mechanically enumerate indexed identity/archive/source predicates and retain deterministic query projections in artifact_index. Verify every projected field against decompressed metadata at write/read; update all SQL expressions, indexes and repository query lanes together without renaming/weakening semantics.

Resolve repeated instrument_key_json index amplification with an immutable canonical instrument/source/revision identity catalog and compact key in source indexes. Retain collision/conflict checks and resolve exact caller identity before query; keep all receipt refs and actual/replay/event/cutoff semantics.

Hydrate through every generic API, page, direct query, restart and exporter path; preserve source_rowid and export cursor semantics. Keep PublicStreamFrameIndexV1's existing archive locator path, and include PublicStreamTradeObservationIndexV1 compatibility in repository-level changes.

Add and enforce a durable finite evidence reserve profile before admission of acquisition; persist accepted population/cadence/duration and cumulative footprint across restart, reserve room for completed snapshot, rejection evidence, clean drain and final report, and stop via the existing irreversible preventive latch before an unreserved cycle.

Prove exact equivalence for legacy/new/mixed stores, invalid/corrupt blocks, interrupted transactions, ties, cutoffs, all query modes, export/restart and complete decision denominators; then run representative sustained workload including stream, enrichment, reporting, WAL readers, restart and maximum supported breadth/duration. Leave authority and capacity unqualified until measurements establish an explicit envelope.
